title: Smart Mart 34-Table Master Architecture ERD Overview
code:
erDiagram
    %% ============================================================
    %% 1. TÀI KHOẢN, KHÁCH HÀNG & SỨC KHỎE (CUSTOMER & HEALTH)
    %% ============================================================
    ACCOUNT {
        int AccountID PK
        string Username
        string Role
        string Status
    }
    MEMBER {
        int MemberID PK
        int AccountID FK
        string FullName
        int TotalPoints
    }
    MEMBERSHIP {
        int MembershipID PK
        int MemberID FK
        string TierName
    }
    HEALTH_TAG {
        int HealthTagID PK
        string TagName
        string TagType
    }
    MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE {
        int MemberID PK,FK
        int HealthTagID PK,FK
        string status
    }
    MEMBER_NOTIFICATION {
        int NotificationID PK
        int MemberID FK
        string NotifType
        boolean IsRead
    }

    %% ============================================================
    %% 2. GIỎ HÀNG, HÓA ĐƠN & MÓN ĂN (TRANSACTIONS & ORDERS)
    %% ============================================================
    CART {
        int CartID PK
        int MemberID FK
        datetime CreatedAt
    }
    CART_ITEM {
        int CartItemID PK
        int CartID FK
        int ProductID FK
        int Quantity
    }
    INVOICE_HISTORY {
        int InvoiceHistoryID PK
        int MemberID FK
        decimal TotalPrice
        datetime PurchaseDate
    }
    INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM {
        int InvoiceHistoryItemID PK
        int InvoiceHistoryID FK
        int ProductID FK
        int Quantity
    }
    MEAL_SUGGESTION {
        int MealSuggestionID PK
        string MealName
        int Calories
    }
    MEAL_ITEM {
        int MealSuggestionID PK,FK
        int ProductID PK,FK
        decimal QuantityRequired
    }

    %% ============================================================
    %% 3. SẢN PHẨM & DANH MỤC (CORE PRODUCT CATALOG)
    %% ============================================================
    CATEGORY {
        int CategoryID PK
        string CategoryName
    }
    SUBCATEGORY {
        int SubcategoryID PK
        int CategoryID FK
        string SubcategoryName
    }
    PRODUCT_TYPE {
        int ProductTypeID PK
        int SubcategoryID FK
        string TypeName
    }
    PRODUCT {
        int ProductID PK
        int ProductTypeID FK
        string ProductName
        decimal UnitPrice
        string Status
    }
    PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG {
        int ProductID PK,FK
        int HealthTagID PK,FK
    }

    %% ============================================================
    %% 4. SƠ ĐỒ SIÊU THỊ & KỆ HÀNG (PHYSICAL STORE LAYOUT)
    %% ============================================================
    FLOOR {
        int FloorID PK
        int FloorNumber
    }
    ZONE {
        int ZoneID PK
        int FloorID FK
        string ZoneName
    }
    AISLE {
        int AisleID PK
        int ZoneID FK
        string AisleCode
    }
    SHELF {
        int ShelfID PK
        int AisleID FK
        int LevelNumber
    }
    SLOT {
        int SlotID PK
        int ShelfID FK
        string SlotCode
    }
    PRODUCT_SLOT {
        int ProductsSlotID PK
        int SlotID FK
        int ProductID FK
    }

    %% ============================================================
    %% 5. BẢN ĐỒ SLAM, ĐIỀU HƯỚNG & ROBOT (SLAM & ROBOTICS)
    %% ============================================================
    MAP {
        int MapID PK
        int FloorID FK
        string MapName
    }
    NAVIGATION_NODE {
        int NodeID PK
        int MapID FK
        string NodeName
        string NodeType
    }
    NAVIGATION_EDGE {
        int EdgeID PK
        int FromNodeID FK
        int ToNodeID FK
        float Distance
    }
    ROBOT {
        int RobotID PK
        string RobotName
        string Mode
        string Status
    }
    ROBOT_LOG {
        int LogID PK
        int RobotID FK
        int Battery
        string Status
    }
    AISLE_SCAN {
        int ScanID PK
        int AisleID FK
        int RobotID FK
        boolean NeedsRestock
    }
    SEMANTIC_OBJECT {
        int ObjectID PK
        int MapID FK
        int ProductID FK
        string ObjectType
    }

    %% ============================================================
    %% 6. THƯƠNG HIỆU & QUẢNG CÁO (BRAND & MARKETING)
    %% ============================================================
    BRAND {
        int BrandID PK
        string BrandName
        boolean IsSystemBrand
    }
    AD_PACKAGE {
        int PackageID PK
        string PackageName
        decimal Budget
        string Status
    }
    AD_CAMPAIGN {
        int AdCampaignID PK
        int PackageID FK
        int BrandID FK
        int SemanticObjectID FK
        string CampaignName
        string Status
    }
    AD_RESOURCE {
        int ResourceID PK
        int AdCampaignID FK
        string ResourceType
    }
    SPONSORED_PRODUCT {
        int SponsoredID PK
        int AdCampaignID FK
        int ProductID FK
        int Priority
    }
    AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG {
        int LogID PK
        int AdCampaignID FK
        string ActionType
        decimal ChargedAmount
    }

    %% ============================================================
    %% RELATIONS: LOCAL DOMAIN FIRST, THEN CROSS-DOMAIN BOUNDARIES
    %% ============================================================
    %% 1. Domain 1 Relations
    ACCOUNT ||--o| MEMBER : "authenticates"
    MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBERSHIP : "holds"
    MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE : "configures"
    HEALTH_TAG ||--o{ MEMBERHEALTH_PREFERENCE : "assigned_to"
    MEMBER ||--o{ MEMBER_NOTIFICATION : "receives"

    %% 2. Domain 2 Relations
    MEMBER ||--o{ CART : "creates"
    CART ||--o{ CART_ITEM : "contains"
    MEMBER ||--o{ INVOICE_HISTORY : "purchases"
    INVOICE_HISTORY ||--o{ INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM : "includes"
    MEAL_SUGGESTION ||--o{ MEAL_ITEM : "suggests"

    %% 3. Domain 3 Relations & Cross-Catalog
    CATEGORY ||--o{ SUBCATEGORY : "divides"
    SUBCATEGORY ||--o{ PRODUCT_TYPE : "classifies"
    PRODUCT_TYPE ||--o{ PRODUCT : "specifies"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG : "has_tag"
    HEALTH_TAG ||--o{ PRODUCT_HEALTHTAG : "applies_to"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ CART_ITEM : "in_cart"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ INVOICE_HISTORY_ITEM : "billed"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ MEAL_ITEM : "ingredient"

    %% 4. Domain 4 Relations
    FLOOR ||--o{ ZONE : "contains"
    ZONE ||--o{ AISLE : "sections"
    AISLE ||--o{ SHELF : "holds"
    SHELF ||--o{ SLOT : "partitions"
    SLOT ||--o{ PRODUCT_SLOT : "allocates"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ PRODUCT_SLOT : "stocked_at"

    %% 5. Domain 5 Relations
    FLOOR ||--o{ MAP : "mapped_into"
    MAP ||--o{ NAVIGATION_NODE : "defines"
    NAVIGATION_NODE ||--o{ NAVIGATION_EDGE : "origin"
    NAVIGATION_NODE ||--o{ NAVIGATION_EDGE : "destination"
    MAP ||--o{ SEMANTIC_OBJECT : "locates"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ SEMANTIC_OBJECT : "mapped_to"
    ROBOT ||--o{ ROBOT_LOG : "records"
    ROBOT ||--o{ AISLE_SCAN : "patrols"
    AISLE ||--o{ AISLE_SCAN : "scanned"

    %% 6. Domain 6 Relations
    BRAND ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN : "sponsors"
    AD_PACKAGE ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN : "configures"
    SEMANTIC_OBJECT ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN : "displays_at"
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_RESOURCE : "presents"
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ SPONSORED_PRODUCT : "promotes"
    PRODUCT ||--o{ SPONSORED_PRODUCT : "promoted"
    AD_CAMPAIGN ||--o{ AD_CAMPAIGN_LOG : "audited_in"
